description: Token Steward: right-size model and effort, and show what that saves. Uses python3, falling back to python where python3 is not on PATH (e.g. Windows).

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook session-start || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook session-start
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook user-prompt-submit || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook user-prompt-submit
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook stop || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/token_steward.py" hook stop
